plan.commit_message:
Add deferred toast flows over classic redirects

Profile form posts outside Turbo (data-turbo=false), the controller
queues a toast with deferToast() and redirects; a fake login POST does
the same with a 303. The bundle cookie subscriber transports the toasts
and forces the redirect responses private.
plan.pr_title: US-004 - Cookie transport on a classic redirect (deferToast)
